suitesSection.title: Room to live,
suitesSection.lede: Three suite categories, with room to settle in. Living rooms, kitchenettes and balconies, with the resort around you.

suites.name: One Bedroom Suite
suites.long: Your own living room, a bedroom, a kitchenette and a private balcony over the gardens. Room for three, with the convertible sofa bed in the living area.

suites.name: Two Bedroom Suite
suites.long: Two bedrooms, a shared living room, a kitchenette and two private balconies. Made for families and friends travelling together, with room for five.

suites.name: Two Bedroom Sea and Garden View
suites.long: A two-bedroom stay with views of the sea and the gardens. Speak with reception to find out more about this category for your dates.

faqSection.title: A few things
faqSection.lede: From cooking in your suite to bringing your pet. The little details, answered.

faqs.q: What kinds of suites are there?
answer: One Bedroom Suites for up to 3 guests (627 sq ft), Two Bedroom Suites for up to 5 guests (1042 sq ft), and Two Bedroom Sea and Garden View suites. The One Bedroom and Two Bedroom suites have a living area with a convertible sofa bed, a kitchenette and private balconies. Contact reception for details of the Sea and Garden View category.

faqs.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
answer: Check-in is at 12 PM and check-out at 10 AM. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability: call +91 72059 70222 or email palmregalresort@gmail.com.

faqs.q: Can we cook in our suite?
answer: Every suite has a kitchenette. Meals are also available at The Shack, our in-house restaurant. Please pre-order to avoid delays.
There's no traditional room service, but The Shack can send a parcel to your suite. Use the crockery in your kitchenette to serve.
Yes. Palm Regal is pet friendly, so bring your furry companions and enjoy the stay together.
Gopalpur main beach is about a five-minute walk from the resort.
Yes, spacious basement parking. Electric vehicle charging is available on request.
Individual bookings: free cancellation up to 24 hours before arrival. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged in full.
Groups of 5 or more rooms: free up to 7 days before arrival, 50% within 7 days, and 100% on the day of check-in or for no-shows.
Date changes are free up to 48 hours before check-in, subject to availability.

faqs.q: Which is the nearest railway station?
answer: Berhampur railway station, about 25 minutes by car.
There's no in-house taxi, but reception can arrange one at extra cost, or share local taxi contacts.
